tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Search live music venues across all 50 US states by keyword, state, regional drive-time area, town or multi-stop driving route corridor (stops, or near / to / within_miles), venue type, room capacity, usual music days, or saved favorites. Returns each venue with its genres, capacity, usual music day

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Read a single venue dossier by venue_id (dated show history, stage dimensions, and source links) without spending a free reveal. Note: `search_venues` already returns genres, capacity, music days, and booking contacts and populates the interactive widget, so only call `get_venue` when you need dated

tools.name: reveal_venue
tools.description: Unlock and return the full venue dossier (booking contacts, music days, and dated show listings) for 7 days by spending 1 free reveal if the venue is not already revealed. Call this only when the user explicitly asks to reveal or unlock a specific venue.

tools.name: find_by_performer
tools.description: Search performer show history across the directory. With All Access, returns every venue where the performer has past or upcoming show listings along with dates and source URLs. Without All Access, returns aggregate show and venue counts across states from the public performer index.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the current user account profile, access level (anonymous, account, or pass), All Access expiration date, remaining free venue reveals, and saved venues count.

tools.name: list_saved_venues
tools.description: List the signed-in user saved (favorite) venues with level-appropriate venue summaries.

tools.name: save_venue
tools.description: Save a venue to the signed-in user favorites list so it syncs across the No Stairs Please website and MCP clients.

tools.name: remove_saved_venue
tools.description: Remove a venue from the signed-in user favorites list.
